speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
text: asked the Minister for Education with regard to the new enhanced curricular structure for ITE students whereby students will experience a three-year pathway leading directly to a Higher Nitec certification (a) what are the Ministry's plans for students who find it more difficult to cope under the new structure; and (b) what are the plans to provide additional support and academic coaching to support them in completing their Higher Nitec certification.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: This gives them a stronger foundation to build on for further education and skills upgrading over their careers.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: ITE will do its utmost to help its students persevere in their learning journey in the following ways.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Second, once these students are identified, ITE will provide them with targeted support in a timely manner.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: ITE lecturers will provide them with appropriate learning scaffolds, additional coaching as well as social and other forms of support.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Third, ITE will beef up the industry exposure elements in its courses and raise their quality.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: It will provide students with early exposure to industry, jobs and careers to better engage them and strengthen their motivation for learning.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: They will be able to sustain and deepen their learning and also strengthen their work-ready skills.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: However, in spite of ITE's best efforts, there will remain some students who will not complete their three-year pathway.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: ITE will encourage these students to take up the second industry attachment in the third year to deepen their workplace learning.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: ITE's strong mission of education and social support and strong industry orientation and focus has benefited many cohorts of students, equipping them with work-ready qualifications and skills to take on skilled jobs in the economy.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: MOE and ITE will continue to support and help ITE students thrive and succeed and fulfil their potential.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: The enhanced pathway, or rather the structure goes a long way into destigmatising ITEs.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: Having taught students who went to the Polytechnics, I truly believe that ITEs is not an acronym for "It's the end", but "It's towards excellence".

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: So, with that, given the increased accessibility to the Higher Nitec, are there plans to increase the places for the Polytechnic intake?

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: And will there be a transition programme for these students in this batch of ITE students as they further their studies at the Polytechnic?

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: It is very heartening for him to translate the much talked about ITE as "It's the end" to "It's towards excellence".

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: I think we want to certainly work towards ensuring our students get the best technical education through the ITE curriculum.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: So, beyond this, we will continue to support upgrading for our ITE graduates via different pathways after their Higher Nitec qualification.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: And if need be, there will be programmes that will support them in the transition.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: There are also other upgrading pathways available to our ITE graduates, such as the Technical Diplomas in the ITE themselves, as well as the Work-Study Diplomas offered by the ITE, which ITE is planning to expand further.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: ITE graduates can also choose from across the different pathways and programmes according to their learning styles and career development needs and aspirations at the appropriate point in time and in accordance with the entry requirements of each pathway.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: So, there are a lot of pathways that our ITE graduates can take up at different points in time in their careers.
